submit.title: Suggest an event
submit.intro: Know a training, fair, scholarship, conference or community event that helps people grow? Send it. A curator checks every suggestion before it appears. You don't need an account.
submit.whatQualifies: We list events that build skills, livelihoods, health or community: trainings and workshops, job and agri fairs, scholarships and fellowships, conferences, faith and youth programmes, sport for development, arts workshops. Not parties or nightlife.
submit.linkHint: The organiser's page or post, starting with https://
submit.descriptionHint: What it is, when, where, and who organises it. A link or a description is enough.
submit.privacy: Please don't include personal phone numbers or private details.
submit.failed: Your suggestion wasn't sent. Check your connection and try again.
submit.rateLimited: We're receiving a lot of suggestions right now. Please try again in a while.
submit.sentTitle: Thank you! Your suggestion was sent.
submit.sentBody: Keep this link to see what happens to it. It's the only way to check, because we don't ask for your contact details.
submit.statusUnderReview: A curator will check it soon.
submit.statusPublished: It's now on Meyalo. Thank you!
submit.statusNotFound: We couldn't find this suggestion. Check that you used the full link.
submit.statusError: We couldn't check right now. Try again later.

consent.title: Before you send
consent.reportNotice: We send your answer, your note and your age group so our team can check this event. We do not ask for your name.
consent.suggestionNotice: We send the link, description and note you gave, with your age group, so our team can review the event. We do not ask for your name.
consent.storage: Our host, Supabase, stores it in France (EU).
consent.deletion: The Privacy Policy says how long we keep it and how to have it deleted at any time.
consent.required: Tick the boxes above to send.
consent.accountNotice: We store your email, your plans (Saved or Going, registered, and your "Did you go?" answers, with a copy of each event) and your city, interests and goals, so you get them back on another phone. Your private notes stay on this phone.
consent.signedIn: If you are signed in, it is linked to your account until you delete the account.
consent.agreeAccount: I agree to create an account with this

privacySettings.title: Privacy and notifications
privacySettings.subtitle: What Meyalo keeps on this phone, what reaches our server, and the choices you made.
privacySettings.ageBody: Asked once when you first send something to us. Under 18, a parent or guardian must agree before you send.
privacySettings.saveFailed: We couldn't save that. Try again.
privacySettings.phoneDataBody: Your city, interests and goals, your plans, hidden and opened events, these settings and a copy of events for offline use. None of it leaves the phone.
privacySettings.clearConfirm: This deletes everything above from this phone, and cancels reports waiting to be sent. You will start again from the welcome screen. This cannot be undone.
privacySettings.clearFailed: Some data could not be cleared. Try again.
privacySettings.cleared: Data on this phone was cleared.
privacySettings.serverBody: Only what you choose to send reaches us: reports and event suggestions, each with the consent you gave. We do not ask for your name. Our host, Supabase, stores them in France (EU). The Privacy Policy says how long we keep them and how to have them deleted.
privacySettings.deleteBody: Deletes your email, backed-up plans, profile and consents from our server at once. We keep only an anonymous record that an account was deleted, for 3 years. Your plans stay on this phone.
privacySettings.deleteConfirm: Delete the account {email}? This cannot be undone.
privacySettings.deleteFailed: The account was not deleted. Check your connection and try again.
privacySettings.deleteCurator: Curator accounts are removed by an admin. Ask the Meyalo team.
privacySettings.deleted: Your account was deleted. Your plans stay on this phone.

permission.later: You can change this at any time in You, Privacy and notifications.

notifications.title: Get reminders for your plans?
notifications.purpose: We remind you the evening before and 2 hours before events you are going to, before registration closes, and ask the morning after how it went.
notifications.never: No ads, no news, nothing you did not plan. Reminders are made on this phone; we never send you messages from a server.

calendar.title: Add events to your calendar?
calendar.purpose: Meyalo opens your calendar's own screen with the event filled in. You choose and confirm.
calendar.never: We only add what you confirm. We never read your calendar or your other events.

reminders.settingOn: The evening before and 2 hours before events you're going to, before registration closes, and the morning after to ask how it went.
reminders.settingOff: Off. Meyalo will not remind you.
reminders.denied: Notifications are turned off for Meyalo in your phone's settings.
reminders.web: Reminders work in the Meyalo app on your phone.
reminders.failed: We couldn't change reminders. Try again.
reminders.howWasItBody: Tell Meyalo if you went, and keep a note of what you got out of it.
